name: Bar
description: A bar along a screen edge with three places (left, center, right) for items that other modules contribute. Which items appear, and how the bar looks, is set in the configuration file.

edge.description: Screen edge the bar sits on

screens.description: Output names the bar appears on; all means every screen

left.description: Item names in the left place, in order

center.description: Item names in the center place, in order

right.description: Item names in the right place, in order

focusScreen.description: Output name that receives keyboard focus from the focus command; empty means the first bar

style.description: How the bar is drawn: one strip, three separate islands, or a frame around the screen

thickness.description: Size of the bar across its direction; unset follows the font size

margin.description: Gap between the bar and the screen edge; unset depends on the style

padding.description: Space at the ends of the strip, or inside each island; unset depends on the style

itemGap.description: Space between items in a place; unset is the small spacing token

placeGap.description: Space between the three places; unset is the small spacing token

itemPadding.description: Padding the bar gives its items along the bar; unset is the medium spacing token

itemRadius.description: Corner radius the bar gives the shapes of its items; unset is the small radius token

radius.description: Corner radius of the strip or of each island; unset depends on the style

frameRadius.description: Radius of the rounded inner corners of the frame; unset is the large radius token

frameBorder.description: Width of the frame on the three sides without the bar; unset is the small spacing token

fontFamily.description: Font family of the bar's text; unset is the design token family

fontSize.description: Text size of the bar; unset is the body text size token

fontWeight.description: Text weight of the bar; unset is regular

backgroundRole.description: Theme role of the solid strip's background

backgroundOpacity.description: Opacity of the solid strip's background

islandRole.description: Theme role of each island's background

frameRole.description: Theme role of the frame (strip, borders and corners)

textRole.description: Theme role of text in the bar

focusRole.description: Theme role of the focus indicator

popupRadius.description: Corner radius of popups; unset is the medium radius token

popupPadding.description: Space between a popup's edge and its content

popupBackground.description: Theme role of a popup's background

popupBorder.description: Theme role of a popup's border
